subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose host update execution over a gateway-authenticated HTTP surface for fleet tools, and if so should that be a dedicated `/admin/update` contract or an intentionally allowlisted wrapper around `update.run`?
rationale: The requested endpoint would give network callers package-update and restart authority, while current HTTP admin surfaces are default-off, allowlisted, and currently expose update status but not update execution.

options.title: Split version metadata and defer update HTTP
options.body: Keep the version field in the narrower public metadata discussion and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

options.title: Expose through Admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add `update.run` only after documenting auth scope, private-ingress expectations, audit/rate-limit behavior, target-version support, and update-handoff failure modes.

options.title: Reject HTTP update execution
options.body: Keep update execution limited to existing CLI/WebSocket/control-plane paths and document that fleet tools should use those or an external orchestrator.

recommendation.title: Split version metadata and defer update HTTP
recommendation.body: Keep the version field in the narrower public metadata discussion and require a maintainer-owned security/API design before exposing update execution over HTTP.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest shared history signal for the update execution and runtime-version surfaces points to this owner candidate.
